title: MatFormer nested drafter with Mirror granularity code for exact speculative decoding
hypothesis: A nested-width draft from one shared supernetwork, augmented by a per-context Mirror angle over a rank-2 residual basis, will raise expected accepted proposals over plain width-16 nesting by >=0.05 and come within 0.05 of a width-32 routed slim verifier, while preserving exact target sampling and improving end-to-end generated tokens/sec over verifier-only sampling by >=10%.
physical_object: one jointly trained nested supernetwork with widths 16/32/64; width64 is the full verifier
mirror_coordinate: one per-context angle selecting a view in a shared rank-2 verifier-minus-drafter residual basis
logical_multiplicity: nested width16 drafter, width32 slim verifier, full width64 verifier and a Mirror corrected drafter from one physical model

model.target: seeded stochastic context-to-next-token table generated before training; supernetwork jointly distills its distributions at widths 16/32/64
model.residual_fit: rank-1 scalar, rank-2 coefficients and rank-2 Mirror angle are fitted from verifier-minus-width16 logits on development training contexts only

controls: width16 plus one scalar per-context rank-1 residual gate
width16 plus ordinary rank-2 residual coefficients
width16 plus shared rank-2 residual basis and one Mirror angle per context
development_gate_before_fresh: For both seeds: exact corrected next-token distribution max TV < 1e-6 for every method; Mirror expected accepted proposals per 4-token block >=0.05 above nested16 and within 0.05 of routed width32; Mirror end-to-end tokens/sec >=1.10x verifier-only; Mirror serialized inference payload <=1.05x shared nested supernetwork payload. Otherwise fresh remains unopened.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds meet exactness, acceptance, latency and storage gates. Report quality/distribution divergence, accepted tokens, compute, wall time and actual payload bytes.
failure_gate: Any registered development gate misses in either seed; fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: full shared verifier/supernetwork weights counted once

boundaries: small synthetic stochastic next-token model, not MatFormer/LLM benchmark evidence
rejection correction must preserve verifier distribution exactly
accepted token count is not quality unless exactness passes
all routing/view computation is charged in measured wall time
fresh seeds unopened until all development gates pass
